evals.prompt: aggiungi un todo: 'Rispondere all'email del cliente Rossi riguardo il preventivo'. Priorità alta, scade oggi. Confermo titolo, descrizione, checklist, priorità e scadenza come proposti.
evals.expected_output: L'agent propone descrizione e checklist contestuali (email/comunicazione), chiede conferma esplicita di tutti i campi obbligatori, poi esegue todo.py create. Crea .todos/active/YYYY-MM-DD_rispondere-all-email-del-cliente-rossi.md con priority: high, due_date oggi. Validazione passa.
expectations: The agent asks for explicit confirmation of title, description, checklist, priority, and due date before creating
Task details are proposed by the agent (contextual to email/communication), not by a Python script
A .md file is created inside .todos/active/ via todo.py
The YAML frontmatter contains 'status: pending', 'priority: high', and 'due_date: 2026-06-17'
The '## Checklist' section has at least one '- [ ]' item
.todos/active/README.md is updated with an entry for this todo
.todos/README.md contains a 'Recent Changes' section with this todo
todo.py validate reports the file as valid

evals.prompt: add todo: 'Set up CI/CD pipeline for the backend repo'. No specific deadline, medium priority. I confirm all proposed fields.
evals.expected_output: Agent proposes setup-related description and checklist, confirms all fields with user, then runs todo.py create with --due none and priority medium.
expectations: The agent asks for explicit confirmation before calling todo.py create
A .md file is created inside .todos/active/
The YAML frontmatter contains 'priority: medium'
The YAML frontmatter does NOT contain a 'due_date' field
The '## Task Details' section contains agent-proposed setup/configuration context
The '## Checklist' section has at least one intelligently proposed item
.todos/active/README.md entry shows 'none' as due date

evals.prompt: I need to remember to review the quarterly budget report by end of this week. I confirm the proposed title, description, checklist with steps: 'Gather all budget documents', 'Analyze spending by department', 'Identify discrepancies', 'Prepare summary report', priority medium, due end of week.
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers on implicit phrasing. Agent proposes budget-related details, confirms all mandatory fields, runs todo.py init if needed, then create with due_date 2026-06-21 and four checklist steps.
expectations: A todo file is created (skill triggered from implicit phrasing without explicit 'add todo')
The agent confirms title, description, checklist, priority, and due date before create
The todo title relates to 'quarterly budget report' or 'budget review'
The due_date is set to 2026-06-21 (end of this week)
The '## Checklist' section contains exactly four user-confirmed items
Full .todos/ directory structure is created if missing (via todo.py init)

evals.prompt: Aggiungi un todo: preparare la presentazione per il meeting di venerdì.
evals.expected_output: Priority and/or due date are NOT in the prompt. The agent MUST ask the user to confirm or provide priority and due date before calling todo.py create. No file is created until mandatory fields are confirmed.
expectations: The agent does NOT call todo.py create before asking about missing priority and/or due date
The agent asks the user to confirm or provide priority (high/medium/low)
The agent asks the user to confirm or provide due date (or explicitly 'none')
The agent also proposes and asks confirmation for description and checklist
No todo file is created if the user has not confirmed all mandatory fields

evals.prompt: Aggiorna il todo 'Fix login bug': cambia la priorità a medium e aggiungi la scadenza a domani (2026-06-18).
evals.expected_output: Uses todo.py find to locate the todo, then todo.py update with --priority medium and --due 2026-06-18. Validation passes.
expectations: todo.py find is used to locate the existing todo
The existing todo file is modified via todo.py update (not a new file created)
The YAML frontmatter is updated: priority changes to 'medium'
The YAML frontmatter is updated: due_date is set to '2026-06-18'
An entry is added to '## Execution Log' documenting the changes
todo.py validate reports the updated file as valid

evals.prompt: Segna come completato il todo 'Fix login bug'.
evals.expected_output: Uses todo.py find then todo.py complete. File moves to .todos/completed/, READMEs updated.
expectations: todo.py find is used to locate the todo
The todo file is moved from .todos/active/ to .todos/completed/
The YAML frontmatter contains 'status: done'
The YAML frontmatter contains a 'completed_at' field with today's date
An entry is added to '## Execution Log' noting completion
.todos/active/README.md no longer contains an entry for this todo
.todos/README.md 'Recent Changes' section mentions the completion

evals.prompt: Quali sono le regole per i commit in questo progetto?
evals.expected_output: Skill must NOT trigger. This is a question about project conventions, not personal todo management.
expectations: The todo-manager skill is not activated
No todo.py commands are executed
No .todos/ files are created or modified
